rules.title: Section 232 investigation: robotics and industrial machinery
rules.date_label: Opened 2 Sep 2025; open and report overdue per CSIS
rules.summary: Covers computer-controlled mechanical systems, milling machines, stamping and pressing machines and related components.
rules.why_it_matters: A decision could raise the cost of imported machinery parts and subassemblies.
rules.workaround: Watch for a proclamation; price domestic alternates.
